content.short: Rainbow is a user-friendly Ethereum wallet with bridging and cross-chain swaps to Layer 2s.
content.description: Rainbow is a secure Ethereum wallet founded in 2019 by Christian Baroni, Jin Chung, and Mike Demarais. It lets you manage and display Ethereum-based assets and connect with NFT and DeFi apps across the Ethereum ecosystem. Available on mobile and desktop, Rainbow features a colorful, intuitive interface that makes finance approachable. It offers native ENS domain support and bridges to Layer 2 networks such as Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism, appealing to both newcomers and power users.
